title: Starting Panthers RT Taylor Moton sidelined with blood clot, potentially clearing path for first-round rookie in critical season for Bryce Young

sources.title: Starting Panthers RT Taylor Moton sidelined with blood clot, potentially clearing path for first-round rookie in critical season for Bryce Young
sources.description: Offensive line play will be key in Carolina as the Panthers continue to evaluate quarterback Bryce Young, who enters his fourth NFL season without a contract extension.
